meta_title: Johnson's Gas & Heating | Central Heating Sunderland
meta_description: Johnson's Gas & Heating in Sunderland. Gas Safe registered boiler repairs, installations and servicing. Same-day emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken in winter? We're Gas Safe registered and aim to have you warm within hours, any time of day.
services_heading: Complete Central Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From annual boiler servicing to emergency repairs and full system installations, we keep Sunderland homes warm and efficient.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently, cutting fuel costs and extending its life. Emergency breakdowns attended same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Expert fitting of modern A-rated condensing boilers. We handle the lot — pipework, flue, controls — and leave your home heating in perfect working order.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots? We balance your system, repair leaks, and fit new radiators to improve heat distribution and comfort throughout your home.

services.title: System Commissioning
services.desc: New heating system? We thoroughly test every component, set the controls, and make sure everything performs as it should before we leave.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual Gas Safety Certificates for rental properties — legally required and completed to the highest standard. We email reports direct to you.

services.title: Power Flushing
services.desc: Built-up sludge and corrosion make boilers work harder and cost more to run. We power flush your system to restore efficiency and reliability.

about_pullquote: I started this because I wanted to be the engineer I'd want in my own home.
about_para_1: Johnson's Gas & Heating has served Sunderland homeowners and landlords for 18 years. We're Gas Safe registered, APHC members, and pride ourselves on turning up on time, fixing the problem right, and charging a fair price. From routine servicing to complex breakdowns, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time.
about_para_2: Our vans are fully stocked with parts, so most repairs are completed in a single visit — no return trips, no surprise bills. We listen to what you need, explain the work clearly, and only recommend upgrades if they'll genuinely improve your home's comfort or cut your heating costs.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed up on a Sunday morning in January. Called Johnson's at 9am, engineer was here by 11, diagnosed a faulty pump, had a spare and fitted it same day. Couldn't ask for better service. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using them for my landlord certificates for three years now. Always professional, turn up when they say they will, and send the paperwork through promptly. Fair pricing too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a radiator leak and didn't know who to call. A friend recommended Johnson's. The engineer was brilliant — explained what had gone wrong, fixed it properly, and even showed me how to bleed the others. Will be ringing them for my boiler service next month.
reviews.author: Emma W.
